description: T5.4 golden set over the 100 core invoices of eval/datasets/v1 (chunks from ../retrieval/corpus.json), asked on 2026-11-11. Written before anything was measured. `lookup`: the answer must cite only retrieved chunks; `invoice` is the invoice that holds the answer. `aggregate`: `expect` is applied by the test to the dataset's expected.json files to get the right number, independently of the SQL; `route` is what a correct model answers, and what the fake model answers in CI. `refusal`: must be refused with `reason`.
